reason: The first reading's syllable groups ('ue biu facte te ta', 'urte uin', 'mica spe') were reread as 'debui facere tibi', 'plantavi te vineam', 'meam spe-' once the Improperia text was known, and the grey 'm' on the smaller scrap's second face was recognised as modern pencil.
sources: Graduale sacrosanctae Romanae ecclesiae (Vatican edition, Rome 1908), Feria VI in Parasceve, pp. 182-183 (archive.org graduale-romanum-1908, n205-n206)
E. Martène, Tractatus de antiqua Ecclesiae disciplina in divinis celebrandis officiis, Good Friday ordo, MDZ bsb10524759, scan 415
Cantus Index 008453 (Quid ultra debui) and 002522 (Ecce lignum crucis)
text:
Source-assisted reading of F-sqjv (Stams, Frg. 23), made with the Cantus Index standard texts and the Graduale Romanum 1908 pp. 182-183 available. All text lines on both faces of both scraps were reread on the native images (canvas 0 = 01r02r, canvas 1 = 01v02v, 7360 x 4912 px). Boxes are x,y,width,height in native pixels. ( ) expansion, [ ] lost or supplied, ? doubt. Text is written in syllables under the notes; neumes not transcribed.

Canvas 0, larger scrap (item 1)
3250,2510,850,140   [d]e bui face re ti[bi]          (text line above the surviving staff; the d is lost at the tear)
2930,2860,1170,150  [E]go(?) quide(m) planta ui te uine[am]   (opening reads "ecto" or "ego" with a damaged g; "ego" not secure; stroke over "quide" = quidem)

Canvas 0, smaller scrap (item 2), same line as the one above
4520,2780,430,140   [m]eā spe c[iosissimam]          (stroke over "ea" = meam)

Canvas 1, larger scrap (item 1)
2880,2380,820,140   [salus mu]ndi pepen[dit]         (top edge, letter tops partly lost)
2880,2780,1270,120  [veni]te? a do re mus | B(red-touched initial)eati[   (red vertical division stroke through the staff above, before B)

Canvas 1, smaller scrap (item 2)
4430,2730,350,140   ]te[                             (only ink text on this face; the grey "m" beside it is modern pencil, part of the shelf label)

Modern pencil, not text: "Stams, STA, Frg. 23-1r", "Frg. 23 2r", "STA, Frg. 23-1v", "Frg. 23 2v".
